description: Accessible NVDA add-on for the Sarvam AI platform, built for blind and visually-impaired users. Text to speech (with document upload and MP3 export), speech to text including large audio files, translation, transliteration, language detection, an AI Workforce reasoning layer (Sarvam-105B), and OCR powered by Sarvam Document Intelligence in 23 languages that preserves headings, tables and multi-column layout. Results save as TXT, Word or Markdown. Fully keyboard accessible.
